# Great West Graphics

> Custom screen printing and embroidery studio in Vancouver, British
> Columbia, founded in 1980. Great West Graphics decorates apparel and
> promotional products for businesses, schools, teams and events, and
> proofs every order before it goes to production.

Great West Graphics is a production print shop, not a print-on-demand
marketplace. Work is done in-house in Vancouver: screen printing,
embroidery, and direct-to-garment printing on blank apparel sourced from
major North American suppliers.

## Services

- Screen printing — up to 37 stock ink colours, with full Pantone Matching
  System colour matching available on request.
- Embroidery — logos digitized stitch-by-stitch and hand-trimmed after
  every run.
- Direct-to-garment printing for detailed or full-colour artwork.
- Branded team and company stores, for organizations that want a fixed
  product selection their people can order from. These run as bulk print
  batches rather than one-off print-on-demand, so a curated product list
  works better than an unlimited catalogue.
- Bulk and repeat orders, including blind/drop shipping on a third party's
  behalf.

## Ordering

Customers can browse the catalogue, build an instant estimate in the quote
builder, or upload artwork in the Design Studio and place it on a garment
before ordering. Every order is proofed before print. Final pricing is
confirmed after the team reviews the artwork.

## Artwork requirements

- Preferred: vector files — PDF, AI or SVG with fonts converted to
  outlines. Vector art scales to any size without losing quality.
- Also accepted: transparent PNG at 300 DPI, at final print size.
- Avoid: screenshots, compressed logos, and images copied from websites.
  These are raster/pixel-based and lose quality when scaled up.

## Shipping

Great West Graphics ships anywhere in Canada and the United States.
Customers can also arrange their own carrier pickup by contacting the
office.
